optimizedDescription.value: Search spec content across workspaces via repositories, with filters, ranking, resilient errors, and optional materialized summaries.

optimizedContext.value:
# SearchSpecs

## Rules

- `SearchSpecs.execute()`: obtain project workspaces via `ListWorkspaces`; call each workspace `SpecRepository.search()` for substring matching; aggregate results.
- Non-empty `options.workspaces`: search matching workspace names only; silently ignore unknown names. Omitted/empty: search all configured workspaces.
- Sort results by descending relevance `score`.
- Each result requires: `workspace`; capability `path`; `title` resolved identically to `ListSpecs`; repository relevance `score`; repository `SpecSearchMatch[]` as `matches`.
- `options.includeSummary === true`: call `GetSpecMetadata.execute({ specId })` using default `if-needed` policy; project normalized `description` into `summary`. Never read repository metadata snapshot or `spec.md` directly. Omit `summary`, without failing search, when materialization yields no projection.
- `options.includeSummary` false/omitted: omit `summary`; never materialize result metadata.
- Per-workspace search error: silently omit that workspace results; continue others; never propagate individual repository I/O errors.
- No matches: return `[]`, never error.
- `createSearchSpecs(config, options?)`: derive `SearchSpecsDeps` only through `resolveSearchSpecsDeps(resolver)`; delegate to canonical `createSearchSpecs(deps)`; never reconstruct fs-shaped wiring inline.
- `resolveSearchSpecsDeps(resolver)`: resolve `listWorkspaces: ListWorkspaces` and `getMetadata: GetSpecMetadata`; never resolve `hasher: ContentHasher` or `yaml: YamlSerializer`.

## Constraints

- Depend on `ListWorkspaces` for consistent fallback-search project traversal.
- Metadata materialization exclusively owns deterministic summary extraction fallback.
